Decision backup, differentiators, market influences, outliers, blind spots, grading and minimum-input submission method

This pack is ready for design-team challenge, not final UI approval. It closes screen coverage and gives Claude Design a defensible direction. Human acceptance is still required per screen family before Claude Code/Fable changes application code. The pack deliberately grades supporting screens as premium rather than forcing theatrical differentiation everywhere.
Give Claude Design repository access and run the existing master constitution, code/runtime discovery and foundations prompts once.
Approve navigation, page headers, tables, status language, maps, evidence, sync and responsive patterns before family screens.
Use the Batch column. Submit 3–8 related screens so Claude can reuse the same components and storyline.
After common context is loaded, paste only the selected row from Claude Prompts. Do not resend the entire BRD or all 43 prompts.
Claude must complete five internal critique passes and return READY_FOR_DESIGN_REVIEW, never self-approve.
Review cohesion, interaction and states across a family before requesting PNG production for the next family.
Claude Code/Fable receives accepted screen prompts, exact route/component paths and required tests/evidence.
Projected route, provider pending, queued locally, published locked and returned-scope-only must never be visually blurred.
Critical criticism of the current approach

Trying to make every screen visually unique would be a mistake: it creates 43 mini-products and guarantees rejection on cohesion. The defensible strategy is one Saqeel grammar with a small number of signature interactions: configuration health spine, regulation-to-runtime trace, criteria-to-map targeting lens, dual-state visit ribbon, geofence confidence card, evidence receipt, immutable submission receipt, semantic version diff and truth-layer operations map. Supporting screens should feel premium through clarity and consistency, not spectacle. Also, ‘no rejection’ cannot be guaranteed honestly; this pack minimizes avoidable rejection by making every decision traceable and reviewable.
